metadata.title: AMD Stock Takes a Bigger Hit as Cracks Emerge in the AI Trade<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
AMD Stock Takes a Bigger Hit as Cracks Emerge in the AI Trade
Advanced Micro Devices tumbled Wednesday as worries about the sustainability of the artificial-intelligence boom hit the chip makers that make AI possible.
